readings.source_reading: An ink arrow at about x450-610, y915-955 points left from between d.330(4) and c.343(7) toward the gutter. Two arrows stand at the level of b.99(3)ᵇ: one at x470-540 in the shelfmark column and one at x215-300, left of the gutter line. At the far left edge of the canvas, at y850-985, a facing-page fragment reads 'kātimahātmya.' / '/11: D.'.
readings.evidence: In native tile 0,0 the arrows match the vertical positions of the c.88(2) entry and the 'Dated San 1257' line on the fol. 260b overview. No written link or wording confirms which entry the arrows refer to.

readings.source_reading: A strike line runs from 'b. 99 (9)' through 'Vyavasthāsaṅgraha', a small cancelled word, 'ritual', 'Begins:-' and 'Praṇamya', then rises through '7:6:' of the formula above. 'n.d.' is not clearly struck. The word under 'n.d.' is struck and illegible. A caret-like stroke under 'ritual' points up. 'Gopālapadāravindam &c.' on the line below is unstruck.
readings.evidence: Native tile 1604,1608, at y about 1500-1610. The stroke over 'Praṇamya' is thin, and its passage through the word is probable but not secure. The source shows no explicit link between 'Gopālapadāravindam' and the cancelled line or d.509.
In native tile 1604,0 the letterforms show 'Sambita' with a looped b. There is no visible ṃ or final ā.
In native tile 0,3216 the final vowel of 'mūlā' carries a macron stroke, and there is a gap between 'Vyākaraṇa' and 'mūlā'.
